subject.title: fix(compaction): accept compaction entries with non-numeric tokensBefore

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override for this internal compaction parser fix, or require after-fix real behavior evidence from an affected transcript/session?
rationale: The author explicitly requested an override because the PR only provides source analysis and unit-test output, while the repository proof gate expects after-fix real behavior evidence for external non-doc PRs.

options.title: Require real behavior proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted transcript fixture, live logs, or reproducible validation transcript showing a `tokensBefore: null` compaction entry is accepted and truncation proceeds after the fix.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: A maintainer can decide that the one-line internal parser hardening plus linked source-repro issue is enough for this PR despite missing live after-fix proof.

options.title: Fold into a broader fix
options.body: Pause this PR and handle consumer tolerance together with producer-side non-finite token normalization in one maintainer-owned patch.

recommendation.title: Require real behavior proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted transcript fixture, live logs, or reproducible validation transcript showing a `tokensBefore: null` compaction entry is accepted and truncation proceeds after the fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The current parser guard and recent transcript-file-state history point to this owner as the best available proof-sufficiency decision route.
